question: Which IPv6 or dual-stack bind contract should OpenClaw expose for Gateway LAN/custom mode?
rationale: The implementation choice changes non-loopback Gateway exposure, platform behavior, and config semantics, and repository policy treats config/default/startup and security-boundary changes as maintainer decisions before automation.

options.title: Add explicit dual-stack opt-in
options.body: Introduce a documented IPv6 or dual-stack bind mode/value with security warnings, platform-specific listener semantics, and fresh-install plus upgrade proof.

options.title: Change LAN/custom in place
options.body: Make existing `lan` or `customBindHost` accept IPv6 directly, accepting the compatibility and global IPv6 exposure risk as the new default behavior for those modes.

options.title: Keep IPv4-only core
options.body: Leave core bind behavior IPv4-only and document reverse-proxy or sidecar workarounds for IPv6-only platforms.

recommendation.title: Add explicit dual-stack opt-in
recommendation.body: Introduce a documented IPv6 or dual-stack bind mode/value with security warnings, platform-specific listener semantics, and fresh-install plus upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history signal for the affected Gateway network resolver and IPv6 loopback behavior points to this owner candidate.
